messages:
Sophie Li: Customer reports a sudden spike of 5xxs when they send a mixed batch (embeddings + generation) in a single request. Happening across multiple regions, started ~08:15 UTC. They see 502/504 and a couple of opaque 599s. They pasted a curl and SDK trace.

Priya Patel: Can you paste the exact curl & SDK version? also need approximate payload sizes and batch composition (how many embed vectors vs generation prompts).

Sophie Li: CURL: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d @payload.json` Payload ~3.2MB, 40 embed rows + 3 short generate prompts. SDK: python 1.4.2. They said retry logic does exponential backoff but ends up with duplicated invoices (billing spike) due to some retries succeeding server-side after timeout.

Marco Rodriguez: This sounds like an ingress pressure + request timeout window issue. Unusual to see 599s with small prompt count. Any edge-proxy logs? Sophie, can you ask for `x-request-id` from their logs (from the response headers) and a timestamp window?

Sophie Li: Sent back asking for headers & timestamp. Customer returned `x-request-id: rwd-79a2b` and local client time range 2026-03-16T08:14:55Z -> 2026-03-16T08:17:10Z. They attached compressed client-side trace and a snippet showing `ReadTimeoutError` then a later `200` for the same logical request ID.

Andrew (oncall): I'm seeing matching entries: a few requests to the hosted-edge in US-W that exceeded our per-connection read window and got reset at the gateway layer. Backends show the model container processed and emitted tokens, but the gateway sent reset upstream after 30s of stalled frames. Likely due to KV-cache lock contention when embeddings + generate are multiplexed into same session.

Marco Rodriguez: Repro idea: create a mixed batch with similar shape locally and hit the edge with our trace tool at varying concurrency. Can someone run a small ramp test (2 -> 50 concurrent mixed requests) and watch p95.

Priya Patel: Running replay now against staging-edge with their payload. Preliminary: at 20+ concurrency, we see sustained stall on streaming worker threads, KV cache locks spike, kernel queue grows. Reproduced 502s after ~28s when stream write buffers stalled.

Andrew (oncall): Temporary mitigation: increase gateway idle streaming window to 60s for the affected route and enable conservative prefix caching for embeddings. Doing a config patch to US-W and EU-W. Will monitor for 10m then roll globally if stable.

Sophie Li: Noted. Told customer we're applying mitigations and asking them to reduce concurrency and try client-side dedup of retries for now. They asked if SDK change is required.

Marco Rodriguez: Long-term fix: split mixed requests server-side into separate execution paths (embeds run in batch engine, generation in stream engine) or add smart in-proxy queuing that avoids KV-cache contention. Filed ENG-RELAY-1283 for orchestration changes.

dev-support-bot: Automated: rollout started for gateway idle window patch -> patch-id gw-idle-20260316-1. Target: us-west, eu-west.

Priya Patel: After idle-window bump, retries dropped by ~70% in staging replays. Edge logs show fewer premature resets. Still seeing a couple of 504s when client-side read buffer is tiny (<64B).

Andrew (oncall): Can we add a short-term customer-facing KB blurb: 1) avoid bundling large embedding batches with interactive generation in a single request; 2) set SDK retry to jittered exponential with max 3 attempts; 3) consider client keepalive > 30s for streaming. I'll draft a snippet.

Sophie Li: Customer update sent: "We applied throttling/timeout workarounds on our side and a gateway tweak on our end. Please test concurrency down to 10 and report. We're working on a permanent fix and will follow up with an SDK recommendation." They replied :thumbsup: and will test tomorrow.

Marco Rodriguez: Follow-up tasks: (a) ENG-RELAY-1283 design doc, (b) add a soft-fail telemetry for mixed requests hitting KV lock high watermark, (c) run a canary rollout of the split-execution change in staging.

dev-support-bot: Automated: ENG-RELAY-1283 created by Marco Rodriguez.

Sophie Li: Will keep thread open for customer's test results. Marking P1 until customer confirms no further invoices spikes.

Andrew (oncall): Noting billing impact: finance flagged a small spike correlated with the retry window. We'll coordinate with billing to offer a credit if needed.

Priya Patel: Logging note: we should capture `client_retry_count` in the request-level telemetry so we can distinguish server-side duplicate successes vs client multi-send. Filing ENG-TELEM-442.

Sophie Li: Thanks everyone. I'll circle back once customer completes the reduced-concurrency test. :eyes:
